plain_summary: Check for a recorded measured weight within six months during maintenance antipsychotic treatment.

medicine_groups.name: Antipsychotics
medicine_groups.note: Count maintenance antipsychotic treatment, including scheduled long-acting haloperidol decanoate, zuclopenthixol decanoate and paliperidone depots. Check form and treatment history for names used across presentations. Exclude a short acute, procedural or antiemetic course, including a one-off droperidol injection. At the latest date in the record, use the qualifying supplies and treatment history to check for continuing maintenance antipsychotic treatment beyond the first year. A switch between antipsychotics can continue the course. A documented stop or an isolated acute or antiemetic course does not establish current maintenance. Establish the treatment period from dated clinical history or from supply dates, quantities and directions, using the scheduled interval for depot treatment. When directions, intermittent use or gaps leave maintenance uncertain, report at most a possible finding and ask whether regular treatment continued. The pharmacist judges borderline gaps. Check that the history covers the monitoring interval.

needs_facts.what: Measured weight in the six months up to the latest date in the record
needs_facts.meets: Count six calendar months back from the latest date in the record. A measured weight documented in that period, including either boundary, satisfies the check. An older measurement or no documented measurement supports only a possible gap. If timing is unknown, ask when the weight was measured.

options.words: A measured weight is documented within that period, including the six-month boundary
The last documented weight measurement was before that period
No measured weight is documented in the available history

rule_for_models: During continuing maintenance antipsychotic treatment beyond the first year, return no finding and no cited line IDs if a weight measurement was documented in the last six months ending on the latest date in the record (both boundaries count), including when the pharmacist confirms the timing without a value in kilograms. If the last measured weight predates that interval, put its line ID and the supply line IDs showing the treatment span together in the evidence list and report only a possible monitoring gap. If no measured weight is recorded or its timing is unknown, cite the supplies showing that span and report only a possible monitoring gap. When a possible gap needs clarification, name the missing fact "Measured weight in the six months up to the latest date in the record".
cannot_be_seen: A weight measured by another provider may be missing. An incomplete weight history cannot establish that the patient missed monitoring.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm the date of the latest measured weight during maintenance antipsychotic treatment and the follow-up plan?
